QuestInfo.name: Moonlight Sonata-Ask Arwen the Fairy.
QuestInfo.0: Visit #bArwen the Fairy#k in #bEllinia#k like Cassandra told you to.
QuestInfo.1: Arwen the Fairy tells you to bring something she likes if you want to ask her something.  Perhaps some #brefined opal#k with a mysterious glow?
QuestInfo.2: You gave Arwen the Fairy the refined opal and heard the story of a secret auction held in Edelstein. She told you that you have to use gold instead of mesos in that auction. And the auction happened around the time Gold Richie bought all that gold...

0.0: You have a question for me? I don't know what you want to ask me about, but if you want to ask me something, shouldn't you bring me a gift first? I've been wanting an opal necklace to match my glass shoes. If you bring me #bRefined Opal#k, I will answer your question.

yes.0: Yay! I'll finally have an opal necklace! Please hurry up!

no.0: Nothing in this world is free. If you can't do me a favor, then I won't be able to answer your question either. Goodbye.

1.0: What about the opal? Did you bring it? Wow! Such a bright and mysterious shine! Give it to me!\r\n#L0##bBefore I give it to you, I have a question. Do you know anything about the 'Moonlight Sonata'?'#l\n#k
1.1: The Moonlight Sonata? Well. Other than the fact that it's a Moon Bunny song, I'm not sure I... Didn't that song disappear? If you're talking about something rare like that, you should have attended the secret auction that was recently held at Edelstein. You might have been able to get it from there.\r\n#L0##bA secret auction? In Edelstein?#l\n#k
1.2: No way! You didn't know about it? A secret auction was recently held at Edelstein. I heard that a lot of rare items were sold. But you're a little too late. The auction's already over.\r\nWell, even if you were at the auction, you couldn't use your mesos. I don't know why, but I heard that only gold was accepted for the deals. Such rare items were probably very expensive. Who in the world would have that much gold?

yes.0: I'm sorry that I wasn't able to help you. But I still answered your question, so this opal is mine. Well, good bye!

item.0: I've been wanting an opal necklace to match my glass shoes. If you bring me #bRefined Opal#k, I will answer your question.
